notes: Fierce Empath (M21): 'When this creature enters, you may search your library for a creature card with mana value 6 or greater, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.' Library: a 6-MV creature, a 5-MV creature, a 7-MV artifact (and a last card the opening draw takes). The controller says yes and asks for the 5-MV creature, which is not a legal find: the only legal card, the 6-MV creature, goes to hand; the 5-MV creature and the artifact stay in the library. Hand: Empath + drawn card, Empath enters -> 1, found card -> 2.
